newAssets.title: Sas latéral orange de la baie — panneau entrouvert observé sur le plateau
newAssets.generationPrompt: Create ONE isolated game sprite of the ORANGE SIDE AIRLOCK of the terraforming bay from Alien: Covenant. The first attached reference is Jacinta Leong's photograph of the actual constructed set: select only the large orange circular doorway at the LEFT FOREGROUND, complete from the top of its rectangular casing to its grey base and attached short metal threshold. Preserve the observed slight three-quarter camera angle, orange slab casing, thick segmented grey circular ring, large brown-grey bolted locking blocks around the ring, close-spaced silver inner ribs, red-orange warning light across the top of the entrance, small dark tilted display on the left jamb, and stacked short grey pipe stubs with orange-dark open ends on each side of the casing. Preserve the visible orange door panel parked at the inner left of the opening, as in this exact photograph; leave the clear central passage genuinely transparent. The second attached reference is Jacinta Leong's production model, used only to clarify the shape of that same side airlock at its left foreground. Do not copy the yellow construction vehicles or the large red terminal bay doors. Keep the photographed orange finish and restrained practical metallic textures; do not turn the model's untextured grey material into the final color. Remove all surrounding hangar walls, foil insulation, ceiling, cables, floor, people, chains, and construction vehicles. Isolate a single complete doorway assembly, do not show a room behind it and do not invent a new passage. Clean detailed cinematic 2.5D prop rendering closely following the physical reference, with neutral light and small confined practical red illumination; no floor shadow outside the object. One subject only, on a portrait canvas, fully visible with generous transparent margins on every edge, true native alpha background and alpha through the actual empty passage. No captions, labels outside the original prop, watermark, diagram, collage, alternate views, or additional assets.

documentaryCandidates.title: Grande porte terminale fermée — candidat documentaire à réviser
documentaryCandidates.generationPrompt: Edit the first attached generated door sprite to correct TWO specific mismatches against the production references. Output ONE corrected isolated closed terraforming-bay terminal door assembly, not a collage. Image 1 is the edit target. Image 2 is Jacinta Leong's set photograph: the grey-and-red terminal doors at the far center are the color/marking reference. Image 3 is Tony Drew's technical drawing: its FRONT ELEVATION at top left is the shape reference. Image 4 is Jacinta Leong's production model showing the same terminal doors at the back. Correction 1: the current cutout is much too wide and low; reconstruct the whole door in the drawing's approximately 2.8:1 visible width-to-height proportions, with its long flat top and bottom and large rounded corners. Do not merely stretch the existing texture. Correction 2: replace the current many repeated right/left arrowheads with the larger red crossed diagonal markings visible on the actual terminal door: mirrored broad red diagonal braces form the observed larger X pattern across grey metal panels, respecting the center seam; directly follow the reference photograph and model, do not invent lettering or symbols. Keep the frontal elevation, thin grey immediate perimeter frame, central vertical closure division, grey metallic panel seams, restrained mechanical fittings and subdued industrial finish. Do not add room walls, floor, people, vehicles, rails, the orange side airlock, window views, text, measurements or labels. Leave closed door leaves fully opaque. Use a landscape canvas with generous transparent margin on every side; preserve genuine native alpha outside the door frame, no cast shadow or background. High-detail cinematic 2.5D game prop, one whole asset.

limits: Contour utile trop haut pour la proportion visée depuis le plan.
Motif rouge simplifié en un grand croisement ; répartition et panneaux exacts à reprendre.
Poignées, subdivision des tôles et usure interprétées depuis des vues éloignées.
Alpha natif mesuré à 253/255 au centre, proche de l’opacité complète mais non maximal ; conservé sans retouche.

continuationContract: Préserver le moteur et les seuils existants. Examiner séparément les états des portes et leurs vues avant toute admission. Aucun panneau ne doit masquer un acteur, un accès ou une commande.
remainingWork: Reprendre les proportions et la distribution du graphisme rouge de la grande porte ; le candidat reste hors production.
Documenter séparément tout état fermé du sas latéral ou ouvert de la grande porte avant de produire un autre état.
Valider un consommateur existant, la projection, le passage, les collisions et les interactions avant une admission dans le rendu.
Les trois états intermédiaires de l’iris du Juggernaut restent manquants ; les deux vues historiques sont conservées.
certification: Aucune fidélité 1:1 certifiée. Un original retenu au catalogue et un candidat documentaire ne terminent pas la famille de décor.
